exposure: history of urinary diversion (UD) during childhood or adolescence
outcome: dilatation of the upper urinary tract
cohort: The study included 25 women who had undergone urinary diversion during childhood or adolescence and became pregnant between 1981 and 2013.
finding: Pregnancy after urinary diversion is possible without major complications, but it should be considered high-risk due to the increased chance of urologic complications.
